title: GSTN Advisory: Ab NIL/Zero Demand Orders ke Against Bhi File Kar Sakenge Appeal!
content:
# GSTN Advisory: Ab NIL/Zero Demand Orders ke Against Bhi File Kar Sakenge Appeal!

Ek important update hai. Government ne taxpayers ko NIL ya Zero demand orders ke against bhi appeal file karne ke liye GST Portal par option enable kar diya hai.

Previously, agar kisi demand order mein "NIL" ya "Zero" demand amount reflect hota tha, khaas kar tab jab taxpayer ne payment order aane se pehle hi kar di ho, toh portal par appeal file karna mushkil hota tha. Ab yeh restriction remove kar di gayi hai.

*   **What's New:** Taxpayers ab Form GST APL-01 ka use karke aise demand orders ke against appeal file kar sakte hain, jahan dispute toh hai liability ka, but demand amount "NIL" ya "Zero" dikh raha hai.
*   **Why This Change:** Yeh un situations ke liye beneficial hai jahan taxpayer underlying tax liability ko dispute karta hai, even though demand order mein koi outstanding payment nahi dikhti kyunki payment already ho chuki hai. Isse Section 107 of the CGST Act, 2017 ke under statutory right of appeal restore ho gaya hai.
*   **Advisory Date:** Yeh facility GSTN ki Advisory dated September 7, 2026, ke through enable ki gayi hai.

Agar appeal file karte samay koi query ya difficulty aaye, toh taxpayers GST Helpdesk par ticket raise kar sakte hain.
